name: Ubercircle
description_en:
Ubercircle is a product in the Social media management category. Its directory profile covers Social Media Monitoring, Posts Scheduling, Multi-User Collaboration, Multi-Account Management, Customer Engagement, Brand Tracking, Auto Publishing, Analytics (Social Media).

Additional listed capabilities include Content Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.99.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track selected social conversations and mentions; organize content through creation, revision and publication. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Ubercircle 属于社交媒体管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括社交媒体监测、帖子排程、多用户协作、多账户管理、客户互动、品牌监测、自动发布、社交媒体分析。

资料还列出内容管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $9.99.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：跟踪指定的社交讨论和提及；组织内容的创建、修订和发布。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
